results.content: # Voices of Sierra Leone (www.VOSL.net) | HOW SIERRA LEONE IS POISED TO POSITIVELY AND MASSIVELY CHANGE THE WORLD … WITH JUST 4 WORDS: | Facebook. HOW SIERRA LEONE IS POISED TO POSITIVELY AND MASSIVELY CHANGE THE WORLD … WITH JUST 4 WORDS:. In the next few years, a simple but innovative platform – "Global Problem Solving (GPS) Engine" – may emerge out of Sierra Leone that not only changes the brand and prosperity of Sierra Leone but also transforms how the world discovers problems, solves problems, learns in school/college/workplace, and manages both improvement and innovation projects. Among many objectives, Sierra Leone’s GPS Engine aims to rapidly and systematically facilitate the training of Genius Innovators & Polymaths (GIPs) as well as entrepreneurs starting from the age of 3 years. So, what are the four words that would positively and massively change Sierra Leone as well as the world?
